For graduate students, we offer master's and doctoral degrees in biomedical engineering, civil engineering, artificial intelligence, computer science, physics, electrical and mechanical engineering, and more.
Applied Physics and Nanotechnology (MS)
Applied Physics and Nanotechnology are interdisciplinary fields built around the application of leading-edge physical principles and concepts.
Applied Physics and Nanotechnology (PhD)
The Doctoral Program in Applied Physics & Nanotechnology prepares students to enter the scientific and engineering workforce as scientists engaged in research and development
Applied Space Weather Research (MS)
The Master of Science in Applied Space Weather Research aims to educate the next generation of scientists and engineers who will attack the challenging problems of mitigating hazards to technological systems susceptible to space weather.
Artificial Intelligence (MS)
The Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence (MSAI) curriculum is designed to provide advanced coursework with practical applications across various AI fields while emphasizing ethical considerations in AI and preparing students to develop and apply AI in ways that promote human flourishing.
Biomedical Engineering (MS)
The Master of Science in Biomedical Engineering program equips students with advanced knowledge and skills at the intersection of engineering and biological sciences.
Biomedical Engineering (PhD)
The Catholic University of America's Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Biomedical Engineering offers a comprehensive and interdisciplinary education that merges engineering principles with biological and medical sciences.
Civil Engineering (MS)
The Master of Science in Civil Engineering builds advanced expertise in one area of civil engineering practice — construction, structures, transportation and systems, water resources and the environment, or civil engineering informatics — on a foundation of graduate-level analysis and computation.
Civil Engineering (PhD)
The PhD in Civil Engineering prepares researchers who can define original problems in their field and solve them rigorously.
Computer Science (MS)
The Master of Science in Computer Science program offers a comprehensive education designed to equip students with advanced knowledge and skills in computing.
Computer Science (PhD)
The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Computer Science program offers a comprehensive and research-focused curriculum designed to advance knowledge and innovation in the field.
Data Analytics (MS)
The Master of Science in Data Analytics program offers an interdisciplinary curriculum designed with guidance from industry leader Booz Allen Hamilton. It equips students with advanced skills in data analysis, statistical modeling, and data-driven decision-making.
Electrical Engineering (MS)
The Master of Science in Electrical Engineering program offers a cutting-edge curriculum designed to equip students with advanced knowledge and skills in areas such as signal processing, communications, power systems, and control systems.
Electrical Engineering (PhD)
The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Electrical Engineering program offers an advanced, research-focused education designed to develop leaders in the field.
Engineering Management (MS)
The Master of Science in Engineering Management is designed to equip engineers with the leadership and management skills necessary to excel in technical and managerial roles.
Environmental Engineering (MS)
The Master of Science in Environmental Engineering prepares engineers to analyze and manage water and environmental systems — treatment of water and wastewater, surface water quality, hydrology, groundwater and contaminant transport, and the geospatial and computational tools these problems now require.
Environmental Engineering (PhD)
The PhD in Environmental Engineering prepares researchers to define and solve original problems in water and environmental systems — treatment processes, surface water quality, hydrology, groundwater and contaminant transport, and the computational and data-driven methods these problems now demand.
Mechanical Engineering (MS)
The Mechanical Engineering program at The Catholic University of America offers students a distinctive educational experience that combines rigorous technical training with a broad-based liberal education rooted in the Catholic intellectual tradition.
Mechanical Engineering (PhD)
The PhD program in Mechanical Engineering at The Catholic University of America combines rigorous advanced coursework with innovative, faculty-guided research in a flexible and supportive academic environment.
Physics (MS)
The Master of Science in Physics prepares students to enter the scientific and engineering workforce as researchers supporting research and development in academia, industry, and government.
Physics (PhD)
The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Physics program prepares students to perform independent scientific and engineering research in Physics and allied disciplines in academia, government, or industry.
Certificate Programs
We also offer graduate-level certificates for those who want to develop their professional skills but not pursue a full degree program. Credits earned through the certificate can be applied towards a relevant graduate degree.
More About Certificate Programs
Accelerated Master's Program
Learn more about our accelerated master’s program that allows students to pursue a bachelor’s degree and a master’s degree in a shorter time than pursuing both degrees separately.
